source: Curated subset — codes anchored by industry-profiles/KSIC*.yaml. Official KSIC 11th-revision names verified 2026-09-10 against the categoryofbusiness.com KSIC-11 database, cross-checked with official 11th-revision renumbering examples (10801→10901/10902, 282 rename) and DART-registered induty codes (두산로보틱스=2928, 한화오션=3111, SFA반도체·DB하이텍=2611). Profile aliases live in the detail field, never in name_ko. Profile anchors corrected 2026-09-10 to the in-force 11th revision (264→261, 29192→29280, 30111→31111, 30303→3131) — see ADR-0111 revision note. Extend from KOSTAT's official list (kssc.kostat.go.kr); not the full ~10k-code master.
